items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was in the Snookum Russell band that I met Fats Navarro... Snookum played pretty good piano and was a good bandleader. He was fun to work for.

ctx.x: Was the first actual professional group that you worked with then when you went with the Clarence Love Orchestra?
I’m trying to remember whether it was Clarence Love. It was probably Clarence Love, which came before Snookum Russell. That would be about right.
